addition.item:
Added granular location data inside the array returned by 
getReferencedImages()
.
Added configuration options and language strings for the options to see all images in the result and scan inside the content for images outside of img tags.
Added a new table column output to see the location and status of all images in the selected folder when the option is chosen in the configuration.
Added a helper method to extract images from text content based on strict (img only tags) or permissive (anything resembling an image).
Implemented the option to allow for more permissive image scanning inside content, instead of only looking inside img tags.

Added a check inside 
addReferencedImage()
to make sure the URL represents an image before adding it to the array.

change.item: Moved the check for an empty form variable of folders to scan from the model into the controller.

Removed the method 
getAllMediaImages()
and moved the logic into 
scanForUnlinkedImages()
.

Clarified the intent with the path manipulation inside the 
MediafoldersField
class.
Moved the check for an invalid entry from the model into the controller delete method.

Modified the return value from the 
scanForUnlinkedImages()
method to return an associative array of the unlinked images and the status of all images.

Set errors inside the model and only output error messages inside the controller view instead of using 
app->enqueueMessage()
inside the model.
Modified language strings for the preview and the directory to better align with the enhanced view.
Removed the options from the return view toolbar because they affect the scan results.

Applied the proper setting of the user state variable 
processed_images
to remove a deleted image from the results in the view that shows all images.

fix.item: Removed the checked attribute from the input tag so the toggle all folders option defaults to unchecked like the other items in the form.
Removed the fieldset rendering for the ignore case option inside the template file.
Deleted the language string related to the form not being loaded since the check was removed.

Removed the path cleaning from the 
scanForUnlinkedImages()
method since paths are already clean.
Removed the duplicate value removal step from all media variables since files are already unique.
Removed the option for case sensitive matching in the scan function and in the configuration options because Linux filesystems treat filenames with different casing as separate files.
Removed the language strings related to case sensitive matching since files with incorrect casing are treated as broken images by the web server.

Deleted the test for the empty form object inside the 
getForm()
method.
Simplified the template by removing the check for the empty form since the view file already checks and handles that condition.
Removed the fallback check for user identity inside the view file and kept the modern Joomla! method of verifying user identity.

Removed unused 
$mediafolders
variable inside the view file.
Removed the form retrieval in the return view file since data is handled directly from the user state.
Removed the empty array fallback inside the template file when retrieving protected variables set inside the view.

remove.item: Removed the case sensitive matching configuration option.
Removed unused language strings related to case sensitive matching.

addition.item: Implemented a custom field for the output to show checkboxes and image data.
Dynamically created image alt tags in the return view based on filenames.
Added scanning support for schema content in Joomla 5.
Added more detailed error messages in try/catch blocks.

change.item:
Changed the model type to 
FormModel
to better reflect its functionality.

Changed 
deleteUnlinkedImages()
to 
deleteUnlinkedImage()
to clarify that it only handles one file at a time.
Clarified the component description.
Removed the word "Component" from the component name.
Changed the table header language string constants for better clarity.
Updated all file versions to 1.3.
Updated language strings and corrected French language string translations.
Updated minimum PHP and Joomla! versions inside the installer script.
Removed Joomla 4 support from the update server and changed the minimum Joomla! version to 5.0.0.

fix.item: Fixed the manifest file by removing the unnecessary version attribute from the XML declaration.
Fixed the update server to use an evergreen ZIP file link.
Corrected the language string shown when folders are missing.

Fixed the 
loadFormData()
function to check if user state data exists before populating the form.
Implemented a custom field for the output to show checkboxes and image data.

Removed the 
getTable()
method from the model since it was unnecessary.
Corrected the form fields to properly handle the renderField method.
Removed unused language string labels from the fieldset and form.

Fixed the form output in the template files to use 
renderField()
instead of iterating through the 
$form
array and outputting HTML.
Improved the error message output when there is an error loading the media folder.

Simplified the logic behind 
deleteUnlinkedImage()
to return true/false.
Removed the duplicate deletion failure error message from the controller.

Replaced deprecated 
getDbo()
calls with 
getDatabase()
.

Removed the 
$unlinkedImages
global variable since it only appeared in one method.

Improved the 
addReferencedImage()
method to remove redundant statement handling valid URLs.

Removed unused global variable 
$form
in the return view file and renamed 
$brokenimages
to 
$unlinkedimages
for consistency.

Fixed comparison bug inside 
getAllMediaImages()
by ensuring leading slashes are added correctly.
Applied minor code formatting improvements.

addition.item: Added scanning support for Joomla 5 schema content.
Added more detailed error messages in try/catch blocks.

change.item:
Changed the controller type to 
BaseController
and removed unused dependencies.
Moved file and folder handling to Joomla API version 2.
Fixed, removed, and updated language strings.

fix.item: Properly implemented case sensitivity checks in both the model and form.
Properly displayed all subfolders inside media folders for scanning.
Added checks and error output for missing media folders.
Fixed update server file syntax.

addition.item: Initial release of the Image Linker component.
